faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.subtitle: The details that make buying art online feel safe.
faq.a1: Orders are made and packed within 24 hours. Delivery takes 2–4 business days within the US and 5–9 internationally. You'll receive tracking the moment your order ships.
faq.q2: Are the frames ready to hang?
faq.a2: Yes. Every framed piece arrives with picture wire and a hardware kit, so it's ready to hang in minutes — no extra trips to the hardware store.
faq.q3: What if I don't love it?
faq.a3: Return it within 30 days for a full refund. We'll email you a prepaid return label — no restocking fees, no questions asked.
faq.a4: Prints are made on 210 gsm archival matte paper or gallery canvas with archival inks rated to last over 100 years. Frames are FSC-certified oak with shatterproof acrylic glazing.
faq.q5: Can I order a custom size?
faq.a5: We offer three sizes in every format. For larger commissions or custom colourways, email us at studio@noewe.art and we'll make it happen.
